newsitem.title: MEXICO: Azucarero Mexico sees 1996-97 sugar production up.
newsitem.headline: Azucarero Mexico sees 1996-97 sugar production up.

text.p: El Grupo Azucarero Mexico, S.A. forecasts that its sugar production in crop year 1996-97 will increase about 53 percent compared to the 1995-96 harvested production, the company said.

"The production estimated for the harvest 1996-97 for the six mills of the group is 542,725 tonnes," compared to 353,427 tonnes of sugar produced in the 1995-96 harvest, Carlos Moreno, the director general of the group, told Reuters in writing.
The 1996-97 sugar harvest runs from November last year to about June this year.
The company has six mills in the states of Nayarit, Jalisco, Tabasco and Veracruz.
The company said that its harvest would make up about 12 percent of the national sugar production.
It said that it sees about 7.7 percent of its harvest being destined for export. ((--Monica Ballesca, Guadalajara bureau (523) 817-0397))
